message:
Dear {{ frappe.db.get_value("Person", doc.person, "first_name") }},

Thank you for your gift of {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(doc.amount) }} to the {{ doc.fund }}. Your generosity is a blessing to the ministry of our church.

A formal receipt is attached for your records.

With gratitude,
The Treasury Team
name: Donation Acknowledgment
subject: Receipt for your gift to {{ doc.fund }}
